cross_verification.note_en: The Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania in Washington, D.C. (its official page, reached via un.int/mauritania/mauritania/visa-forms, listing address 2129 Leroy Place NW and phone (202) 232-5700) was fetched directly and confirms '4 passport-sized photographs' are required for a visa application, but publishes no size, background, or composition specification. No other official Mauritanian government page with visa photo specs was located (see mr-passport note on ANRPTS / procedures.gov.mr, which also does not publish photo specs). Third-party photo-service sites publish specific numbers but were excluded as non-official per the truthfulness gate.
